stem_book: Two samples of HCl of 1.0 M and 0.25 M are mixed. Find volumes of these samples taken in order to prepare 0.75 M HCl solution. Assume no water is added. (I) 20 mL, 10 mL (II) 100 mL, 50 mL (III) 40 mL, 20 mL (IV) 50 mL, 25 mL (a) I, II, IV (b) I, II (c) II, III, IV (d) I, II, III, IV
key: d I, II, III & IV (all give the 2 : 1 ratio)
work: (1.0V₁ + 0.25V₂)/(V₁+V₂) = 0.75 ⇒ 0.25V₁ = 0.5V₂ ⇒ V₁ : V₂ = 2 : 1 — all four pairs are 2 : 1
